Title: General availability: New Australia Central region added to Azure HDInsight

Body.Content:
Azure HDInsight is a managed, full-spectrum, open-source analytics service in the cloud for enterprises. You can use open-source frameworks such as Hadoop, Apache Spark, Apache Hive, LLAP, Apache Kafka, Apache Storm, R, and more.

HDInsight is now generally available in Australia Central.  For more information about HDInsight, see the Azure HDInsight documentation.
